release_notes:
v1.0.10+10 - Streamlined Single Entry Point for Song Tutorials & Clean Separation of Course Video Lessons
- Guest Hub & Catalog: Designated as the sole, authoritative entry point for on-demand public song tutorials and masterclasses with micro-tuition time passes (10/20/250 BOB)
- Upgraded Upload Engine: Prominent Cloudflare R2 MP4 video and PDF sheet music upload cards with real-time byte progress indicators and instant status verification
- Rebranded Course Video Lessons: Rebranded Sidebar Item 8 to 'Course Video Lessons' (badge: 'Syllabus'), exclusively dedicated to enrolled student curriculum lessons accessible via course tuition with zero time-pass prompts
- Automated Container Course: Auto-provisions and groups guest tutorials under 'Guest Song Tutorials & Masterclasses', ensuring zero accidental clutter in academic syllabi
- In-App Auto-Updater: Zero-egress Cloudflare R2 ASAR delivery ready for 1-click update across all school administrator terminals
